next_questions: Issued charter and head boat licenses are still unpublished. This Bay sample does not add a commercial-directory grant. The newspaper terms require written consent before public or commercial reuse. Opened operator pages reserve rights in their own content.

Whether the supported Bowers length, dated from a May 31, 2022 newspaper, matches one documented hull, and whether an Anglers Road operator length and a commercial-index length are the same boat. The county directory index returned HTTP 404, so other Bay listings were not counted.
The most useful next primary source is the Coast Guard PSIX search form at https://cgmix.uscg.mil/psix/psixsearch.aspx. It returned HTTP 200 as a form and was not queried.
